d: How far did the Vikings travel into North America? Josh Gates sets out to investigate one of history's most intriguing archaeological mysteries in Expedition Unknown. From authenticated Norse settlements in Newfoundland to the controversial Kensington Rune Stone in Minnesota, Josh follows clues that could reveal just how far Viking explorers ventured into the continent. With the help of archaeologists and experts, he examines ancient artifacts, investigates mysterious inscriptions and explores underwater sites in search of evidence.
